ido-alessia-165cm-d-cup-silicone-compani.heading: Alessia Has One Question
ido-alessia-165cm-d-cup-silicone-compani.paragraph: Alessia sits on a metal chair, listening to your explanation for arriving late. Her long ash-brown hair falls over one shoulder, and her silver trousers catch the light as she settles in for the story. You begin with traffic, move on to a missing address, and somehow end up describing a street you have never visited. She lets you finish. Then she asks one small question: did you actually leave when you said you did? There goes the carefully rehearsed version. Alessia seems perfectly willing to wait for the interesting one.

ido-alessia-167cm-f-cup-silicone-compani.heading: Alessia Takes the Scenic Route
ido-alessia-167cm-f-cup-silicone-compani.paragraph: A pink helmet rests under Alessia's arm as she waits beside the motorcycle. You have brought a route with every stop accounted for; she has brought one question about the road disappearing behind the trees. Her ash-brown hair falls against her leopard-patterned top as she studies the map, then points to a turn you have carefully avoided. Apparently, that is the interesting part. You suggest keeping to the schedule until lunch. She agrees, rather too readily, and asks whether lunch has an address. The destination can stay on the map. Alessia would like a little more say in how you get there.

ido-alessia-169cm-c-cup-silicone-compani.heading: Alessia Changes the Subject
ido-alessia-169cm-c-cup-silicone-compani.paragraph: Mid-sentence, Alessia points toward the enormous floral painting while you attempt a serious explanation of its meaning. Her ash-brown hair is tied back, and she lowers her sunglasses as though this theory deserves a closer look. You make it through color, composition, and most of a sentence about symbolism before she asks whether you actually like it. From beside the green sofa, the question sounds almost unfair. You admit that you do. She settles her knitted wrap around her shoulders and nods. Excellent. Now that the important part is settled, perhaps you can stop explaining the flowers and enjoy the room.

ido-isabelle-170cm-f-cup-silicone-compan.heading: Isabelle Keeps the Reservation
ido-isabelle-170cm-f-cup-silicone-compan.paragraph: Somewhere between the door and the counter, you spot Isabelle, her wide-brimmed hat making your hurried entrance feel a little underdressed. A pearl necklace catches the light above her black dress. You apologize for changing the reservation, then start explaining the advantages of the new place. She listens until you mention that it has no tables before nine. There is a pause long enough to reconsider your plan. Isabelle taps a gloved finger against her chin and asks whether you canceled the first booking. You did not. Good, she says. For once, your indecision has been remarkably useful.

ido-laura-165cm-d-cup-silicone-companion.heading: Laura Revises the Guest List
ido-laura-165cm-d-cup-silicone-companion.paragraph: “I have some stories for you,” Laura says from beside the standing lamp, ready to recount the evening's finest mishaps. Her long light-brown hair falls across a pale robe, with the rose satin dress still visible beneath it. You ask how the party went and immediately regret leaving so early. There was a speech, apparently, followed by another speech explaining the first. Laura has opinions about both. By the time she reaches the dessert course, you are laughing too hard to offer a defense of the host. She draws the curtains and proposes a shorter guest list for next time. Two people, she says, should considerably improve the conversation.

ido-laura-167cm-f-cup-silicone-companion.heading: Laura Calls a Time-Out
ido-laura-167cm-f-cup-silicone-companion.paragraph: From the orange chair, Laura looks over the afternoon itinerary, her light-brown hair resting against a plaid overshirt. You have fitted three errands and a late lunch into a remarkably optimistic hour. She reads the list once, glances toward the curtains, and asks which part is supposed to be enjoyable. You point to lunch. That settles it, apparently. In the imagined pause that follows, the errands lose their urgency and the restaurant gains an earlier reservation. Laura folds the paper with the satisfaction of someone who has improved a complicated plan. There is still time for everything, she says. Just not everything today.

ido-laura-169cm-c-cup-silicone-companion.heading: Laura Has Already Decided
ido-laura-169cm-c-cup-silicone-companion.paragraph: The plan was simple until you arrived with three different suggestions for the weekend. Laura glances up, sunglasses resting in her shoulder-length blonde hair, gold bracelets catching the light beside her pink cardigan. You describe the first option in considerable detail. She asks about the second before you reach the parking arrangements. By the third, you suspect she has been waiting for you to arrive at an answer she found ten minutes ago. She has. Laura points out that the little place you dismissed has a terrace and no timetable. You begin a fresh list of advantages. She laughs and tells you the decision was the easy part.

ido-lilith-167cm-f-cup-silicone-companio.heading: Lilith Requests an Encore
ido-lilith-167cm-f-cup-silicone-companio.paragraph: You find Lilith at the corner table just as the band announces its final song. Her light-brown hair falls around a skull-patterned top, and she pushes her sunglasses back while you insist that you really should leave. A metal bracelet taps against the table in time with the opening notes. You know that rhythm. So does she. Lilith raises one eyebrow, giving your sensible plan a fair chance to survive the chorus. It does not. You sit down again and agree to one more song, which she accepts with suspicious ease. Neither of you mentions how long a good encore can last.

ido-lilith-175cm-d-cup-silicone-companio.heading: Lilith Chooses the Record
ido-lilith-175cm-d-cup-silicone-companio.paragraph: Halfway through the evening, you find Lilith beside the floral sofa, already reconsidering the invitation. Her turquoise wrap dress and white boots suggest she was ready to go; the record sleeve in this imagined scene suggests she has found a better offer. You ask whether the party has been canceled. No, she says, only your plans to attend it. Beneath the dark display cabinet, she makes room for you and turns the sleeve over to inspect the track list. There is a small debate about which side to play first. Lilith wins that one, too. At least this invitation comes with music you actually wanted to hear.

ido-meilan-170cm-f-cup-silicone-companio.heading: Meilan Checks the Forecast
ido-meilan-170cm-f-cup-silicone-companio.paragraph: Clear skies all afternoon, you promise Meilan as she waits beside the car. Her glasses catch the light as she looks from you to the sky, then back again. The closed umbrella rests between her black gloves, its rose-shaped handle adding a small flourish to a very practical decision. You explain that carrying it will be unnecessary. She agrees that you are welcome to test that theory. A moment later, the first drop lands on the roof. Meilan does not say anything immediately. She simply offers you the door and allows the weather to finish the conversation.

ido-sara-153cm-c-cup-silicone-companion-.heading: Sara Knows the Answer
ido-sara-153cm-c-cup-silicone-companion-.paragraph: By the time you step into the quiet study, Sara is already seated in the carved dark chair beside a vintage cabinet. A gold bracelet shifts at her wrist as she considers the unfinished sketch in this imagined scene. You offer to help, which earns a small smile and a question about a missing pen. You check the desk, then the cabinet, then the desk again. Sara waits with the patience of someone enjoying a familiar routine. Only when you start searching your pockets does she point to the pen tucked behind your ear. It seems you have contributed more to the evening than either of you expected.
